_doc: SHIP gate row #13 — per-category classifier accuracy benchmark dataset. Hand-labelled ground truth for the content-based reclassifier in chitti-news/backend/services/news_db.py and the per-category sub-agents. Each row carries: title, expected_category (national / state / politics / business / sports / entertainment / tech), and a one-sentence rationale. Versioned; re-run after classifier changes.
_methodology: 30 hand-labelled seed rows here (5 per category) covering the most-confusing edge cases the production system has historically mis-classified (e.g. FIFA-in-Amazon-Prime-Day must be Business not Sports per recent commit 7466a91; Telugu-film-business-deals must be Entertainment not Business). The remaining 170 rows will be sampled from production over 30 days to hit 200. Eval at scripts/category_classifier_eval.py (TO BUILD) computes F1 per category.
_pass_threshold: F1 >= 0.85 per category; F1 >= 0.92 on politics specifically (mis-classifying politics is the highest-risk failure mode for neutrality and bias).
